The season ran from 25 February to 26 November 2006. [[G.D. Sagrada Esperança|Sagrada Esperança]] were the defending champions. The league comprised 14 teams, the bottom three of which were relegated to the 2007 [[Gira Angola]]. [[C.D. Primeiro de Agosto|Primeiro de Agosto]] were crowned champions, while [[F.C. Bravos do Maquis|Bravos do Maquis]], [[Progresso Associação do Sambizanga|Progresso do Sambizanga]] and [[Sporting Clube Petróleos de Cabinda|Sporting de Cabinda]] were relegated.{{cite web |url=http://www.portalangop.co.ao/angola/en_us/noticias/desporto/2006/9/41/Agosto-New-National-Champions,69cf1de3-1264-4d84-afa5-5984c6d4b8e3.html |title=1º de Agosto New National Champions |publisher=ANGOP.com |date=15 Oct 2006 |access-date=14 Dec 2014 |archive-date=4 March 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304045409/http://www.portalangop.co.ao/angola/en_us/noticias/desporto/2006/9/41/Agosto-New-National-Champions,69cf1de3-1264-4d84-afa5-5984c6d4b8e3.html |url-status=dead }} [[Manucho|Manucho Gonçalves]] of [[Atlético Petróleos Luanda|Petro Luanda]] finished as the top scorer with 16 goals.{{cite web |url=http://www.portalangop.co.ao/angola/en_us/noticias/desporto/2007/9/43/Football-Petro-Manucho-Best-Scorer-First-Division-Championship,9682959c-bf08-4c55-86d9-034682bc2f84.html |title=Football: Petro's Manucho Best Scorer Of First Division Championship |publisher=Federação Angolana de Futebol |date=22 Oct 2007 |access-date=8 Sep 2015 |archive-date=4 March 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304103801/http://www.portalangop.co.ao/angola/en_us/noticias/desporto/2007/9/43/Football-Petro-Manucho-Best-Scorer-First-Division-Championship,9682959c-bf08-4c55-86d9-034682bc2f84.html |url-status=dead }} ==Changes from the 2005 season== '''Relegated:''' [[Académica Petróleos do Lobito|Académica do Lobito]], [[Atlético Petróleos do Huambo|Petro do Huambo]], [[Sporting Clube Petróleos do Bié|Sporting do Bié]]
